results.name: Invalid Credentials / Malformed OTP Rejection
results.precondition: Unauthenticated client attempt to verify OTP
results.steps:
1. Submit malformed 6-digit OTP ("000000") to verifyOtp endpoint
2. Inspect response error code
results.observed: Status 400: Invalid or expired OTP code
results.securityImpact: Protects against brute-force and unauthenticated access
results.remediation: Rate limiting + generic error responses in place

results.name: Expired Session Token Rejection
results.precondition: Session JWT expired (iat: past, exp: past)
results.steps:
1. Pass expired JWT in Bearer header
2. Verify API rejects request with 401
results.observed: Status 401: Unauthorized: Session expired
results.securityImpact: Prevents indefinite replay of captured access tokens

results.name: Global Session Revocation on Logout
results.precondition: Active user executes logout
results.steps:
1. Call supabase.auth.signOut({ scope: "global" })
2. Invalidate refresh token on server
results.observed: Active refresh tokens count: 0
results.securityImpact: Prevents session hijacking post-logout
results.remediation: Global scope logout configured in useApexStore.ts

results.name: Token Misuse / Synthetic Mock Account Bypass Prevention
results.precondition: Adversary creates synthetic client session without OAuth signature
results.steps:
1. Attempt to inject synthetic user "google-user-12345"
2. Verify auth fails closed
results.observed: Synthetic mock account creation completely removed; fails closed
results.securityImpact: Eliminates unauthenticated bypass backdoor

results.name: Cross-User Data Isolation (User A reading User B private garage)
results.precondition: User A authenticated with JWT sub: "user_a"
results.steps:
1. Query garage table with filter user_id = "user_b"
2. Verify RLS policy restricts returned rows to user_a
results.observed: Returned 0 rows
results.securityImpact: Prevents BOLA / IDOR private collection enumeration

results.name: Cross-User Resource Mutation (User A modifying User B profile/XP)
results.precondition: User A attempts to execute UPDATE profiles SET xp = 99999 WHERE id = "user_b"
results.steps:
1. Send UPDATE payload with target user_b
2. Verify RLS rejects operation
results.observed: Direct cross-user UPDATE blocked by RLS
results.securityImpact: Prevents IDOR privilege escalation

results.name: Client Direct XP / Column Privilege Escalation Prevention
results.precondition: User A attempts to update own profile row to set xp = 1000000
results.steps:
1. Execute UPDATE profiles SET xp = 1000000 WHERE id = auth.uid()
2. Trigger `protect_profile_stats_trigger`
3. Verify direct column update blocked
results.expected: Exception: Direct update of stats prohibited
results.observed: Database trigger protect_profile_stats_trigger blocks unauthorized column mutation
results.securityImpact: Prevents arbitrary point and coin inflation

results.name: Malformed JSON Payload Handling
results.precondition: Malformed JSON string sent to /api/analyze
results.steps:
1. POST malformed string "{ make: Ferrari, " to /api/analyze
2. Verify JSON parse error caught gracefully
results.observed: Status 400: Invalid JSON payload format
results.securityImpact: Prevents unhandled crashes and prototype pollution
results.remediation: Safe JSON parsing with typed schemas in api/analyze.ts

results.name: Oversized Payload / Memory Exhaustion Defense
results.precondition: 100MB Base64 payload transmitted in HTTP body
results.steps:
1. Check body size limit against 10MB threshold
2. Verify early rejection
results.observed: Status 413: Payload Too Large: Maximum image size is 10MB
results.securityImpact: Protects backend serverless memory from DoS exhaustion

results.name: Boundary Value & Negative Number Sanitation
results.precondition: Client submits negative or astronomical horsepower/speed stats
results.steps:
1. Submit hp: -500, topSpeed: 999999
2. Verify stats bounded to physical vehicle limits
results.observed: hp: 0, speed: 600
results.securityImpact: Prevents database corruption with negative or overflow values
results.remediation: Math bounding logic in record_car_scan RPC

results.name: Duplicate Reward Claim Idempotency
results.precondition: User claims daily mission reward "mission_1"
results.steps:
1. Execute claim_reward(user_1, mission_1)
2. Immediately execute second claim_reward(user_1, mission_1)
3. Verify second claim rejected with duplicate error
results.expected: First claim succeeds, second claim throws "Reward already claimed"
results.observed: Idempotency table reward_claims rejects duplicate claim
results.securityImpact: Prevents unlimited coin and XP duplication exploits

results.name: Scan Replay Protection & Image Hash Deduplication
results.precondition: User scans a car yielding photo SHA-256 hash H
results.steps:
1. Store image hash H in recent_scan_hashes
2. Adversary replays identical scan with hash H
3. Verify second scan rejected
results.expected: Replay scan rejected with duplicate error
results.observed: Duplicate image hash rejected by scan pipeline
results.securityImpact: Prevents replay attacks using downloaded photo files

results.name: Scan Cooldown Concurrency Locking (3s minimum gap)
results.precondition: User executes scan at T0
results.steps:
1. Record last_scan_timestamp
2. Submit next scan at T0 + 500ms
3. Verify rejected by cooldown rule
results.expected: Scan at 500ms rejected, scan at 3500ms allowed
results.observed: Server enforces 3000ms minimum cooldown with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE row locks
results.securityImpact: Prevents automated high-frequency bot scanning
results.remediation: Cooldown check in schema.sql record_car_scan RPC

results.name: HTTPS Strict Enforcement & Zero Cleartext HTTP
results.precondition: Scan repository and Android network configuration
results.steps:
1. Inspect network_security_config.xml
2. Verify cleartextTrafficPermitted is false
results.observed: Android OS network security configuration blocks all unencrypted HTTP traffic
results.securityImpact: Mitigates man-in-the-middle network interception
results.remediation: network_security_config.xml active and registered in AndroidManifest.xml

results.name: OAuth URL Hash Token Scrubbing
results.precondition: User redirected back from OAuth flow with #access_token=... in URL
results.steps:
1. Capture access token from URL fragment
2. Execute window.history.replaceState to wipe URL
3. Verify access_token no longer in location bar
results.expected: URL hash scrubbed; clean location bar
results.observed: URL immediately scrubbed in App.tsx on session capture
results.securityImpact: Prevents token leakage in browser history and HTTP Referer headers
results.remediation: URL hash scrubbing implemented in App.tsx

results.name: Production API 500 Error Sanitization
results.precondition: Internal server error occurs in API layer (e.g. database timeout)
results.steps:
1. Trigger 500 exception in /api/analyze
2. Verify production response returns generic message without internal stack traces
results.expected: Generic 500 error string without stack trace or IP addresses
results.observed: Error message sanitized in api/analyze.ts for production runtime
results.securityImpact: Prevents information disclosure of backend infrastructure topology

results.name: Android 12+ Targeted Data Extraction & Cloud Backup Rules
results.precondition: Inspect data_extraction_rules.xml and backup_rules.xml
results.steps:
1. Verify database and LevelDB storage excluded from cloud backup
2. Verify sharedpref excluded from cloud backup
results.expected: database, sharedpref, and app_webview excluded from backup
results.observed: XML rules strictly exclude sensitive LevelDB and auth tokens from cloud backup
results.securityImpact: Prevents session token cloning across device restore backups
results.remediation: data_extraction_rules.xml and backup_rules.xml configured in AndroidManifest.xml

results.name: FileProvider Private Directory Scoping
results.precondition: Inspect file_paths.xml
results.steps:
1. Verify external-path root removed
2. Verify camera_cache and camera_images scoped strictly to internal cacheDir/filesDir
results.expected: No external-path root; scoped to cache-path and files-path
results.observed: FileProvider scoped strictly to private application cache and file directories
results.securityImpact: Prevents third-party apps from reading arbitrary external storage via FileProvider URIs

results.name: Component Export Audit (Single Launcher Activity Exported)
results.precondition: Inspect AndroidManifest.xml
results.steps:
1. Verify only MainActivity has android:exported="true"
2. Verify FileProvider is exported="false"
results.observed: Only launcher activity is exported; zero unprotected background services or broadcast receivers
results.securityImpact: Eliminates unauthorized IPC invocation attack surface

results.name: Sliding-Window Rate Limiting (20 req / 5 min)
results.precondition: Client makes rapid succession of AI scan analysis requests
results.steps:
1. Submit 20 rapid requests (allowed)
2. Submit 21st request within window
3. Verify 429 Rate Limit Exceeded returned
results.expected: First 20 requests 200 OK, 21st request 429 Too Many Requests
results.observed: Sliding-window rate limiter in api/analyze.ts blocks excessive traffic
results.securityImpact: Protects backend AI quotas and mitigates automated bot abuse
results.remediation: Sliding-window rate limiter active in api/analyze.ts

results.name: Play Integrity Request-Hash Cryptographic Binding
results.precondition: High-value vehicle scan payload with SHA-256 requestHash
results.steps:
1. Compute requestHash on client
2. Recompute requestHash on server
3. Verify server matches client hash; rejects tampered payload
results.expected: Matching hashes for authentic payload; mismatch for tampered payload
results.observed: Cryptographic requestHash binds integrity token to specific payload
results.securityImpact: Prevents man-in-the-middle token replaying and payload modification
